/ {
	#address-cells = <0x02>;

	};

	memory@800000000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x00 0x00 0x42000000>;
	};

	memory@86ea00000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x6ea00000 0x00 0x1600000>;
	};

	reserved-memory {
		#address-cells = <0x02>;
		#size-cells = <0x02>;

			compatible = "watari,ramdisk";

		};
	};
